title: Workflows feature files in tests/features/
rationale: AGENTS.md and PRD §12 list workflows/export.feature, workflows/import.feature, workflows/binding.feature as required feature files in tests/features/ but they only exist in tests/bdd/features/. The spec layer is missing.
evidence: AGENTS.md §Feature Files lists workflows/export.feature, import.feature, binding.feature in tests/features/. Directory tests/features/workflows/ does not exist. Files only at tests/bdd/features/workflows/.

title: Teams CRUD and management feature files
rationale: PRD §9.3 specifies Team entity, TeamMembership, team-scoped resources, team deletion policy, ownership picker, team notification endpoints — all require BDD coverage. No tests/features/teams/ directory exists. PRD §12 V1 test list specifies team_*.feature files but none exist anywhere.
evidence: PRD §9.3, §12 (V1 Feature Tests: teams/team_create.feature, team_membership.feature, team_pipeline_visibility.feature, team_hitl_gate.feature, cross_team_isolation.feature, admin_override.feature, team_deletion_blocked.feature, ownership_picker.feature, stale_jwt_revocation.feature, view_as_team_non_admin_rejected.feature). Zero exist in tests/features/ or tests/bdd/features/. Unit tests exist at tests/unit/db/crud/test_team.py and test_team_membership.py. Integration tests at tests/integration/crud/test_team_isolation.py.

title: SSO / OIDC / SAML feature files
rationale: PRD §9.4 specifies SSO as an enterprise-gated feature with OIDC and SAML 2.0, JIT provisioning, SSO team mapping, and provider config UI. No feature files exist at any test level. Security-critical enterprise feature.
evidence: PRD §9.4 specifies OIDC via authlib, SAML 2.0 via python-saml, JIT provisioning, group-to-team mapping. No .feature files found in tests/features/ or tests/bdd/features/. Unit tests: none found for SSO flows.

title: Cost controls feature file
rationale: PRD §8.10 specifies token budgets, run budgets, daily spend limits, circuit breakers, org/team-level admin limits — all core to monetization and operational governance. No BDD feature file exists.
evidence: PRD §8.10 details token_budget, run_budget, daily_spend_limit, circuit_breaker, org_daily_run_limit, org_daily_spend_limit, team_daily_run_limit, limit enforcement atomicity. No tests/features/cost/ directory. Unit tests exist at tests/unit/core/cost_controller/test_cost_controller.py. Integration tests at tests/integration/crud/test_cost_attribution.py.

title: API rate limiting feature file
rationale: PRD §7.18 specifies Redis-backed token bucket rate limiting on 5 endpoint groups. Critical for production multi-worker deployments. Only a 7-line placeholder exists in tests/bdd/features/model_backends/rate_limiting.feature.
evidence: PRD §7.18 table: POST /api/v1/runs (60/min), webhooks (100/min), MCP trigger_pipeline (60/min), HITL review (20/min), any MCP tool (200/min). BDD placeholder file is a TODO (7 lines). Unit tests at tests/unit/rate_limiter/test_rate_limiter.py.

title: Audit viewer and export feature file
rationale: PRD §8.12 specifies AuditEvent recording (free tier) vs viewer/export (enterprise gate). Recording has a feature file but the viewer UI, pagination, search, export, and enterprise gate enforcement have no test coverage.
evidence: PRD §8.12: 'Immutable AuditEvent records. Written in alpha; viewer UI in v1.' PRD §5.1: audit_viewer is an enterprise-gated feature. Only event_recording.feature exists in tests/features/audit/. PRD §12 lists no audit viewer feature files.

title: License management feature file
rationale: PRD §5.1 specifies PlanContext, FreeTierPlanContext, LicenseKeyPlanContext, Ed25519-signed license keys, enterprise feature gates, /settings/license page, sidebar tier badge. Entire licensing/monetization layer has no BDD coverage.
evidence: PRD §5.1: PlanContext interface, FreeTierPlanContext default, LicenseKeyPlanContext with Ed25519 verification, enterprise feature gate list, /settings/license page spec, sidebar tier badge spec, planStore Pinia store. No .feature files found for any of these.

title: Run retention and checkpoint cleanup feature file
rationale: PRD §8.8 specifies configurable run retention TTL (default 90 days), nightly retention job (batch 500), LangGraph checkpoint blob deletion, admin purge action, HITL overdue warning. No feature file exists.
evidence: PRD §8.8 (Long-Running Pipeline Retention): retention job runs nightly, batches of 500, advisory lock 'run_retention_job', deletes checkpoint blobs, retains audit_events. No .feature files found. No dedicated integration tests found.

title: Organisation deletion and export feature file
rationale: PRD §6.2 specifies soft-delete (30-day grace), export window, hard delete, configurable retention for regulated orgs, and migration CLI (modulo export-org / import-org). No BDD feature file exists.
evidence: PRD §6.2 (Organisation Deletion Policy): soft delete, 30-day export window, hard delete after 30 days, configurable retention period. PRD §14: migration CLI for self-hosted→SaaS. Integration tests at tests/integration/crud/test_org_deletion.py. No .feature files.

title: WebSocket reconnection and event replay feature file
rationale: PRD §5.3 specifies WebSocket reconnection protocol with REST re-fetch, since_event_seq parameter, 100-event ring buffer, terminal run fallback. Critical for reliability — no feature file exists.
evidence: PRD §5.3: disconnect → GET /api/v1/runs/{id} → reconnect with ?since_event_seq=N → ring buffer replay. PRD §12: 'WebSocket reconnection and event replay are tested as dedicated Python integration tests (not Playwright).' No integration tests found for ring-buffer replay. No .feature files.

title: Cron trigger feature files
rationale: PRD §8.5 specifies cron trigger type with schedule, timezone, input_template. Marked v1. no dedicated feature file in tests/features/. bdd/features/pipelines/scheduling.feature exists but no tests/features/ spec.
evidence: PRD §8.5: Trigger entity with cron type, config_json.cron fields (schedule, timezone, input_template). PRD §12 V1 test list does not include cron triggers. tests/bdd/features/pipelines/scheduling.feature exists but tests/features/triggers/ has no cron file.

title: Agent signal trigger feature file
rationale: PRD §8.5 specifies agent_signal trigger type for cross-pipeline signals. No feature file exists anywhere, including tests/bdd/features/.
evidence: PRD §8.5: agent_signal type with source_pipeline_id, source_node_id, signal_schema_id, fires child pipeline run when source node completes. No .feature files found anywhere.

title: Conditional transitions / kick-back edges feature file
rationale: PRD §14 V1 Extended specifies kick-back edges, conditional transitions (JMESPath conditions), and parallel branches. These change pipeline topology fundamentally — no test coverage exists.
evidence: PRD §14 V1 Extended: 'Kick-back edges, conditional transitions, parallel branches.' No .feature files found for any of these. No unit tests found for JMESPath condition evaluation in graph context.

title: Plugin registry and installation feature file
rationale: PRD §10.2 specifies Python entry-point groups for plugins (connectors, evals, model_backends, schema_types), build-time installation mechanism, and library integration links. No feature file exists.
evidence: PRD §10.2: modulo.connectors, modulo.evals, modulo.model_backends, modulo.schema_types entry points, build-time only installation, UI generates pip install command. Unit tests at tests/unit/plugin_registry/test_plugin_registry.py. No .feature files.

title: Community library registry publish/pull feature file
rationale: PRD §8.14 specifies community registry protocol, Ed25519 signing, trust tiers, and library primitive publication flow. Registry is a primary acquisition vector — no feature file exists for registry operations.
evidence: PRD §8.14: community library, registry primitives, source='registry' discriminator, verified/community trust tiers, publisher program (v2). Unit tests at tests/unit/registry/test_registry.py, test_publisher_trust.py, test_crypto.py. No .feature files.

title: MCP OAuth 2.0 feature file
rationale: PRD §5.4 specifies MCP OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, redirect_uri validation, state parameter, scopes. Security-critical protocol change.
evidence: PRD §5.4 (V1): full OAuth 2.0 via authlib, PKCE mandatory, exact redirect_uri, state parameter, no tokens in query strings, scopes. No .feature files found.

title: SCIM provisioning feature file
rationale: PRD §9.4 (V2 roadmap) specifies SCIM /v2 endpoints with team sync. Enterprise provisioning integration.
evidence: PRD §9.4 (V2): SCIM provisioning with team sync. Unit tests at tests/unit/scim/test_scim_provisioning.py. No integration tests or .feature files found.

title: JWT token lifecycle and security feature file
rationale: PRD §7.10 specifies JWT access tokens (15-min), refresh tokens (7-day, rotated), token family invalidation, WebSocket auth tokens, algorithm pinning, SECRET_KEY entropy enforcement. Auth is a security boundary.
evidence: PRD §7.10: access tokens 15-min, refresh tokens 7-day rotated, token family invalidation, ws-token endpoint, algorithm pinning HS256, SECRET_KEY ≥ 32 bytes, auth rate limiting. No dedicated .feature file. Partial coverage in tests/bdd/features/auth/login.feature and api_keys.feature.

title: Sensitive data DOM masking feature file
rationale: PRD §7.17 specifies server-authenticated reveal, 30-second TTL, '●●●●●' default rendering, no CSS-only hiding. Security control against browser agents and DOM scrapers.
evidence: PRD §7.17: sensitive values are '●●●●●' in DOM, server-authenticated reveal, 30-second display window, DOM cleared after expiry, CSS visibility not a security control. No .feature files found.

title: Ownership picker feature file
rationale: PRD §8.4 specifies ownership picker on every resource creation — no silent default. Cross-cutting UI pattern that touches all entity creation flows.
evidence: PRD §8.4 (Resource Ownership): every resource creation dialog presents an ownership picker, no silent default, pre-selected for single-team users but still shown. No dedicated .feature file.

title: Frontend E2E Playwright tests for all views
rationale: Only 1 frontend test file exists (frontend/src/__tests__/DashboardView.spec.ts). PRD §12 specifies Playwright tests for all interactive elements with data-testid. 16 Vue views exist with minimal or no frontend-side coverage.
evidence: Frontend views: VariantCompareView, TeamComparisonView, SettingsTeamsView, SettingsSsoView, SettingsObservabilityView, SchemaInferenceView, RunDetailView, PipelineEditorView, OnboardingWizard, LibraryView, LibraryPipelineWizard, FeedbackInboxView, EvalEditorView, DashboardView, AdminAuditView, ABTestModelsView. Only DashboardView has a spec file. PRD §12: 'Every interactive element has data-testid — no exceptions.' Playwright tests run via pytest-bdd layer (backend).

title: Run Context Propagation feature file
rationale: PRD §8.18 specifies run_context seeding, context-setter agent role, write enforcement pre-node guard, write-log with last-write-wins, complexity-reviewer agent. Core alpha feature.

Unit tests at tests/unit/core/run_context/test_autonomy.py, tests/unit/pipeline_engine/test_context_setter_enforcement.py. No .feature files.

Integration tests at tests/integration/feedback_manager/test_feedback_flow.py.

Only at tests/bdd/features/connectors/schema_inference.feature. Unit tests at tests/unit/core/test_schema_inference.py. Integration tests at tests/integration/crud/test_schema_inference_integration.py.

title: Run Variants / A/B Testing feature file in tests/features/
rationale: PRD §8.19 specifies variant groups with run_context_overrides, weighted runs, comparison view, eval coverage gap signal. Only exists at tests/bdd/features/pipelines/run_variants.feature — missing from tests/features/ spec layer.
evidence: PRD §8.19: variant group entity, weighted runs, comparison view (eval scores, cost, HITL outcomes, output diffs), eval coverage gap signal, partial completion with HITL, pre-eval degraded mode, variant group run limits, prompt version comparison. Only at tests/bdd/features/pipelines/run_variants.feature. Unit tests at tests/unit/db/crud/test_variant_group.py. Integration tests at tests/integration/crud/test_variant_group.py.

title: Multi-backend database abstraction feature files
rationale: ADR 002 specifies SQLite and MariaDB backend support with app-level tenant filtering. Only Postgres is tested in BDD — SQLite/MariaDB tenancy paths have no coverage.
evidence: ADR 002: GenericRepository with WHERE-clause tenant filtering, MariaDB async driver proof, conditional Alembic DDL, abstract advisory locks. Delivery tracker task-nv12-multi-backend-tests exists as pending. No .feature files for non-Postgres backends.

title: Checkpoint blob encryption feature file
rationale: PRD §7.12 documents plaintext checkpoint blobs as a known security gap. Fernet encryption is required before multi-tenant SaaS.
evidence: PRD §7.12: checkpoint blobs contain agent inputs/outputs in plaintext, documented known gap, v2 plans Fernet encryption. Delivery tracker task-nv12-checkpoint-encryption exists. No feature file or integration tests.

title: LangGraph checkpoint org isolation feature file
rationale: PRD §6.2 documents thread ID prefixing as partial isolation only. Subclass PostgresSaver with org_id required before SaaS.
evidence: PRD §6.2: LangGraph checkpoint tables lack organisation_id, thread ID prefixing is application-layer only, subclass PostgresSaver required in v2. Delivery tracker task-nv12-checkpoint-org-isolation exists. No .feature files.

title: SDLC onboarding path feature file

evidence: PRD §8.16 (SDLC onboarding path): 5-step process from connecting tools to running pipeline. PRD §2 lists existing SDLC onboarding as a primary selling point. Delivery tracker task-nv5-sdlc-onboarding-path exists. No .feature files for the integrated flow.

title: Run cancellation mechanics feature file

evidence: PRD §8.8: @cancellable_node decorator, cancellation_requested flag, asyncio.wait_for per-node timeout, cancel from awaiting_human releases claim, cancel from waiting_for_lock releases advisory lock. Unit tests at tests/unit/pipeline_engine/test_decorator.py. No .feature files.

title: Library rating system feature file in tests/features/
rationale: PRD §8.14 specifies rating system (1-5 weighted, one rating per user per primitive, self-rating blocked, 10-min cooldown, requires prior copy-to-adapt). Only exists at tests/bdd/features/library/ratings.feature — missing from tests/features/ spec layer.
evidence: PRD §8.14 (Rating System): one rating per user, self-rating blocked, requires prior copy-to-adapt, 10-min cooldown, weighted average with review count, abuse report queue. Only at tests/bdd/features/library/ratings.feature. Unit tests at tests/unit/library_service/test_ratings.py.

rationale: PRD §8.15 specifies schema conflict resolution on bundle import: same structure → reuse, different structure → disambiguation suffix. Workflow import is a primary onboarding path.
evidence: PRD §8.15 (Schema conflict resolution): if same abstract_name + same structure → reuse, different structure → disambiguation suffix + warning, no auto-merge, no silent version bump. No .feature files found specifically for conflict resolution.

title: Stage board search/filter/sort feature file

No dedicated .feature file. Existing at tests/bdd/features/ui/pipeline_builder.feature but no tests/features/ spec file.

evidence: PRD §5.1: enterprise feature gates validate on startup via Ed25519 license key, FreeTierPlanContext returns False for enterprise features, enterprise-gated UI elements show lock icon + disabled control + tooltip. No .feature files for PlanContext enforcement scenarios.

title: Webhook payload retention and replay feature file
rationale: PRD §8.5 specifies retain_payload storage in webhook_payloads table with Fernet encryption, access control, 7-day default TTL, background cleanup job. TriggerEvent replay from stored payloads.
evidence: PRD §8.5: retain_payload storage (Fernet-encrypted), webhook_payloads table, 7-day default TTL (max 90 days), nightly cleanup job, operator/admin role restriction on access, TriggerEvent replay action. No dedicated .feature file.

title: Agent theme CSS and testid coverage feature file
rationale: PRD §8.4 specifies ?mode=agent theme, GET /api/v1/viewmodel/current endpoint, full data-testid/ARIA requirements, CSS custom property mechanism, focus rings. All Playwright tests run against agent theme — needs systematic coverage.
evidence: PRD §8.4: Agent Theme (v1), GET /api/v1/viewmodel/current contract (500 pipeline summary cap, overflow flag, pending_hitl inclusion), zero decorative padding, focus ring CSS custom properties, data-testid on all interactives. tests/bdd/features/ui/theme_switching.feature exists but no tests/features/ spec. PRD §12: 'Playwright tests run against the agent theme by default.'

title: SecretsBackend (Vault/AWS) integration feature file
rationale: PRD §7.13 specifies pluggable SecretsBackend interface with Vault and AWS Secrets Manager implementations (V2). Unit tests exist but no integration test or feature file.
evidence: PRD §7.13: pluggable SecretsBackend interface (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager) for v2. Unit tests at tests/unit/secrets_backend/test_vault_backend.py, test_aws_backend.py, test_fernet_backend.py, test_factory.py. No integration tests or .feature files.

evidence: PRD §8.1: ModelBackend credential rotation creates new Fernet-encrypted credential record + health check before replacing old one. PRD §8.6: Connector credential rotation same pattern. Individual rotation.feature files exist in tests/features/model_backends/ and tests/features/connectors/. No end-to-end rotation flow coverage across both in tests/bdd/features/.
